logs.title: Server logs
logs.collected: When you visit the site, the server records the visitor’s masked IP address, the requested page, the referrer and the user agent.
logs.purpose: This data is used for audience measurement and for the security of the site.
logs.retention: It is kept for 90 days at most.
logs.tracking: No cookie and no tracking script is used.
